fixes: After pickup, hide the world parcel or visibly attach a carried copy to the player: in frame-003 the yellow cube still sits on the ground beside the character while the HUD claims 'parcel in hand', which reads as a disconnect.

During the drive leg (frame-003) the green destination is only a distant teal beam; add a directional pointer or waypoint marker plus the remaining-distance readout so the 24 m route is unambiguous without prior knowledge.

The HUD panel has a ragged left-edge tail and inconsistent width between states (compare frame-000 vs frame-003/007); give it a fixed anchored background box so it stays stable across objective changes.

Mark the green pad more strongly in world space (brighter ring/decal plus a taller beacon) so the delivery zone reads as a deliberate destination in frame-007 rather than a flat patch partly hidden by the car.
On completion, hold or fade the ending banner with a visible star/state change and keep the delivered parcel visible on the pad, so the ending is unmistakable in a single still frame.
review.summary: The scoped mission_complete check is supported by real gameplay evidence across the scheduled captures. frame-000 (t=3.2s) shows the Courier HUD with a live proximity objective ("reach the parcel (4 m)") and controls line including the new F plus preserved E and R. frame-003 (t=7.9s, just after the 7.43s pickup anchor) correctly switches to "parcel in hand / drive to the GREEN pad (24 m)", and the trace shows genuine input-driven motion (player walk-away/return before pickup, then ~17.4 m horizontal vehicle displacement before the 14.35s delivery anchor). frame-007 (t=15.2s) shows the unmistakable ending: "★ DELIVERY COMPLETE ★ / The parcel has been delivered. / R to reset" with the car parked on the green pad. frame-009 (t=18.5s) is the post-reset (17.13s) initial state, matching the reset anchor rather than being mislabelled as pre-reset. Regression gates (walk/world/motor) all pass with no blocking regression. The blockout art is far from the photoreal target, but that is polish, not this scope; the route, pickup input, drive leg and ending are coherent and readable.
